source.member: ACE.Server.Entity.DamageEvent.CalculateDamage(Creature attacker, Creature defender, WorldObject damageSource = attacker, MotionCommand? attackMotion, AttackHook attackHook = null)
source.notes: in.attacker / in.defender describe each combatant: class (Player | Creature), id, wcid, attributes[i] = [init, ranks] (Strength..Self), vitals = [[init, ranks, current]] (Health, Stamina, Mana), skills = [[id, sac, init, ranks]], ints/floats/bools/strings = [[property, value]], enchantments = [[spellId, category, power, statModType, statModKey, value]] (layer 1, start 0), location = [cell, x, y, z, w, qx, qy, qz], body_parts = [[key, dtype, dval, dvar, base_armor, bh, [hlf mlf llf hrf mrf lrf hlb mlb llb hrb mrb lrb]]] (a defender creature's weenie has the same table, wcid unique per case), equipped = items in EquippedObjects order (class, id, the same property lists), state = combat mode, stance, forward command (CurrentMotionState = new Motion(stance, forward)), attack type and height, and for players the power/accuracy bars, IsLoggingOut, PKLogout (players have a PhysicsObj that is OnWalkable). in.attack_motion is the monster's motion (null = none); in.seed seeds ThreadSafeRandom (new System.Random(seed)). out is every DamageEvent field; out.bdm = [BaseDamage.MaxDamage, Variance, DamageBonus, DamageMod, VarianceMod, ElementalBonus, MaxDamage, MinDamage] or null; out.armor lists the armor layers' ids; out.rng_after is ThreadSafeRandom.Next(0, 1000000) after the call (the draw count).
